page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m4.4xlarge is a general purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile features 16 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 64.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for file systems and persistent state. Peripheral acceleration is absent, with zero GPUs provisioned. For networking, the server is configured with a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its symmetrical resource footprint and dedicated CPU allocation, the configuration provides steady execution capability without the cost overhead of dedicated local NVMe drives. It is suitable for balanced enterprise workloads, including web application servers, containerized microservices, build nodes, and mid-sized transactional databases requiring network storage.
